name: extension
description: A highly customizable, QoL-focused browser extension for Stardance

scripts.build: esbuild plugins/*.ts --bundle --format=iife --outdir=dist/plugins && esbuild content.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/content.js && esbuild popup.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/popup.js && esbuild importer.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/importer.js && esbuild onboarding.ts --bundle --format=iife --outfile=dist/onboarding.js && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../extension.zip . && cd ..
